cases.name: start-resets-a-finished-search
cases.covers: START drops hits, index, progress and error and keeps only the new query.

cases.name: append-first-hits
cases.covers: The first hits activate index 0 and bucket by page object number.

cases.name: append-more-hits
cases.covers: Later hits extend existing page buckets and add new ones; the active index is kept.

cases.name: append-empty-advances-progress
cases.covers: An empty APPEND is a new object with only progress changed.

cases.name: set-active-unchecked
cases.covers: The reducer stores the index it is given; wrapping is the capability's job.

cases.name: unknown-action
cases.covers: An action outside the union returns the same state.
